name: Band Row
steps: Anchor a band at lower-chest height, face it with an end in each hand, and step back into tension.
Set your feet hip-width apart with soft knees, chest tall, and core braced.
Drive your elbows smoothly back beside your torso until your hands reach your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly back toward the anchor without letting your shoulders slump forward.
tips: Keep your torso upright and still as tension increases at the back of the pull.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears throughout the row.
